content.decision: Replace 48-group / 200+ item collapsible sidebar with 10-category flat list. Each category links to a hub page showing permission-filtered module cards in a grid.
content.rationale: The sidebar had become unusable — 48 collapsible groups, 130+ icon imports, 951 lines. Users couldn't find modules. A flat category list with hub pages gives a clean 2-click navigation pattern: category → module.
alternatives_considered: Keep collapsible groups but collapse all by default — still 200+ items when expanded
Search-based nav (command palette) — not discoverable for new users
Mega-menu dropdown on hover — bad on mobile, complex to implement
Category sidebar with expandable sub-items — intermediate complexity, chose simpler hub pages instead
impacts: All existing module pages untouched — bookmarked URLs still work
Dashboard quick actions updated to link to hub routes
